meta.description: V0 scenario-generation configuration. CAUSE-layer data only -- no traffic-state values (queue, density, flow, speed, shockwave) may ever be added here.
changelog: 0.2.0: corrected route structure to the real 3-edge in->via->out chain; corrected north/south/east/west -> edge mapping using the real network directions; added normal_controller.py compatibility aliases; added an informational (unused-by-generator) signal-phase reference block pending link-index resolution.
0.3.x: regime-stratified LHS scenario design (34 scenarios) -- SUPERSEDED, see 0.4.0.

0.4.0: replaced the regime-stratified LHS design entirely with a fixed set of exactly 12 hand-authored scenarios (8 development + 4 OOD), per explicit project requirement. Removed demand_bands range-widening that only existed to support LHS sampling (reverted to original values). Added approach_patterns.north_extreme and composition_patterns.heavy_vehicle_extreme, both explicitly OOD-only and deliberately more extreme than their development-scenario counterparts (north_heavy, hgv_heavy). Removed v0_design.regime_stratification (no longer applicable -- there is no regime-targeted sampling anymore). v0_design.target_scenario_count is now a literal, enforced 12.

network._movement_map_provenance: CONFIRMED from the actual network (1o->51o, 2o->52o, 3o->53o, 4o->54o intermediate structure supplied directly). Routes are generated as the full 3-edge chain [in_edge, via, out].
network._route_edge_override_note: Escape hatch only: {"in_edge": {"movement": ["edge1", "edge2", ...]}} overrides the canonical movement_map chain for that specific (in_edge, movement) pair.

_signal_reference._purpose: INFORMATIONAL ONLY. Not read by scenario_builder.py.
_signal_reference._structural_analysis: Green link groups: phase0={0,1,6,7}, phase2={2,8}, phase4={3,4,9,10}, phase6={5,11}. Standard dual-ring layout: through+right phase then protected-left phase per opposing approach-pair.
_signal_reference._unresolved: Cross-referenced against normal_controller.py's own comments (phase0/phase2=EW, phase4/phase6=NS), not independently verified against raw <connection> data at config-authoring time. dataset/trajectory_utils.py's derive_phase_green_edges() derives this directly from sq.net.xml's <connection linkIndex=...> data at feature-build time and will warn loudly if it disagrees.

_controller_compatibility._purpose: normal_controller.py requires fields name, demand, demand_rate, approach_distribution. scenario_builder.py writes these as explicit alias fields on every scenario.json: name (= scenario_id), demand_rate (= demand_rate_veh_per_hour), demand (= demand_class, a print-only label in the controller).
_controller_compatibility._approach_distribution_requirement: normal_controller.py requires approach_distribution to contain exactly the keys north/south/east/west summing to 1.0 (tolerance 1e-5).

_webster_reference._purpose: Constants mirrored from normal_controller.py, used ONLY to compute an INFORMATIONAL Webster Y-ratio diagnostic per scenario (stored in scenario.json, printed in the generation report). Does NOT drive scenario generation or split assignment in this version -- v0.4.0 uses a fixed, hand-authored scenario set instead of regime-targeted sampling.

_demand_bands_note: Multipliers of baseline total_demand_veh_per_hour=1600. Reverted to original (un-widened) values in v0.4.0 -- the earlier widening only existed to support Webster-Y regime-targeted LHS sampling, which no longer exists. Used here only to label demand_class informationally.
_approach_patterns_note: south_heavy added in v0.4.0 (needed for the south_heavy development scenario -- no prior pattern was direction-parametrized). north_extreme added in v0.4.0 for north_extreme_OOD ONLY: deliberately far more skewed than north_heavy (0.70 vs 0.45 on the dominant approach), so the OOD scenario is genuinely outside what north_heavy exposes during development, not a relabeled duplicate. Do not use north_extreme for a development-split scenario.
_movement_pattern_note: V0 applies one movement_distribution identically across all four approaches.
_composition_patterns_note: heavy_vehicle_extreme added in v0.4.0 for heavy_vehicle_OOD ONLY: 60% heavy vehicles (hgv+bus) vs hgv_heavy's 30% (hgv+bus) and baseline's 20% -- deliberately well outside the development-scenario range, not a relabeled duplicate of hgv_heavy. Do not use heavy_vehicle_extreme for a development-split scenario.

v0_design.strategy: fixed_hand_authored_12_scenario_set (8 development + 4 OOD) -- see EXPERIMENT_DESIGN.md / scenario_builder.py's SCENARIO_DEFINITIONS

_v0_design_note: v0.4.0: no LHS sampling, no regime stratification, no seed replication, no hand-designed-edge-case phase -- the entire scenario set is the fixed SCENARIO_DEFINITIONS list in scenario_builder.py. target_scenario_count/development_scenario_count/ood_scenario_count are enforced exactly (12/8/4), not just informational.
